subject: Rotating technical deep-dive kickoff — calendar sync and time options
messages:
From: Anna Sora <anna@soracloud.io>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: david.lin@acme-ai.com, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync — technical kickoff for hands-on sessions

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. SoraCloud is ready to move to a hands-on kickoff with Redwood engineers. Key asks from our side:
- 90-minute working session (prompt templates & routing validation + short load sanity test)
- Shared agenda in advance; we'll bring two engineers (David + Priya) and an SRE
- We have participants in US (PST), EU (CEST) and APAC (SGT) — prefer rotating times so the same team isn't always on late.

Can you propose 3 slot options across the coming 2 weeks? Timezone conversion would help. Also, is it possible to include a short KV/prefix caching demo during the session?

Attachments: — none from my side yet; will confirm attendees tomorrow.

Cheers,
Anna
Director of Integrations | SoraCloud
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: Anna Sora <anna@soracloud.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Rotating technical deep-dive kickoff — calendar sync and time options

Anna — thanks, excited to run this. Proposed plan attached (deep-dive-agenda-v1.pdf) plus a short load-test plan (load-test-plan.xlsx). High-level:
- 90 min agenda: 20m prompt review & desired outcomes, 30m routing + model variant tests, 20m live KV/prefix cache demo, 20m light load run + monitoring walkthrough.
- Goals: confirm routing policies, validate prompt templates across model variants, and run a 10–15 minute load sanity (10–50 concurrent tokens/sec) to surface config needs.

Time options (all converted with primary time shown as UTC):
1) Tue Apr 20, 15:00 UTC — US-friendly (PST 08:00 / CEST 17:00 / SGT 23:00)
2) Wed Apr 21, 09:00 UTC — EU-friendly (PST 02:00 / CEST 11:00 / SGT 17:00)
3) Thu Apr 22, 00:00 UTC — APAC-friendly (PST 17:00 prev day / CEST 02:00 / SGT 08:00)

We can rotate so subsequent working sessions shift by ~8 hours to spread the burden. Which slots work for you + David + Priya? If none, tell us 3 customer-preferred windows and we'll match engineers.

Attaching the agenda and load-test plan.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: deep-dive-agenda-v1.pdf (PDF), load-test-plan.xlsx (XLSX)

Karthik / Anna —
Quick note from the engineers: Wed Apr 21 09:00 UTC looks best for our EU folks, but our APAC engineer (Priya) has a client demo then. Can we move to Thu Apr 22 00:00 UTC? That gives Priya a normal morning in SGT.

Also: can you include a short checklist in the shared agenda for API keys, test data, and tracing hooks? We want to have all logs accessible to correlate latency spikes during the load run.

Thanks,
David

Thanks David — good call. Happy to pivot. Two quick operational notes:
- We'll list the API key + test data checklist at the top of the agenda PDF so everyone has it before the call.
- For the load sanity run, we'll cap token throughput to the ranges in the attached sheet; if you want a higher plane, flag it and we'll provision a short burst on Dedicated for the test.

Karthik — can you confirm which Redwood engineers will join at Thu Apr 22 00:00 UTC? I can bring Jonas for routing and I can run the KV/prefix cache demo. Also: I'll drop a calendar invite with "rotating" in the title so we can mark which follow-up session moves +8 hours.

-M

Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

All — Thu Apr 22 00:00 UTC is confirmed from our side. Engineers assigned:
- Marissa Cole (routing + KV demo)
- Jonas Weber (load/config + observability)
- Karthik Iyer (session lead, prompt review)

I've scheduled the invite: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/rdw-9843-deepdive (please accept). Agenda and checklist are attached (deep-dive-agenda-v1.pdf). Note on rotation: next working session (if recurring) will shift +8 hours to cover APAC-friendly morning for the SoraCloud team.

Thanks — looking forward.
Karthik

- If possible, enable tracing links in the dashboard so we can click through from a token sample to the trace.

See you on Thu.
Anna
